A clean, flat textbook illustration showing a four-quadrant chart of the Greek types of love. Top-left: Agape (symbolised by hands holding a heart with a cross inside). Top-right: Phileo (symbolised by two friends with arms around each other's shoulders). Bottom-left: Eros (symbolised by a married couple holding hands). Bottom-right: Storge (symbolised by a mother holding a child). White background.

A two-panel illustration showing practical ways of demonstrating Christian love in a Nigerian context. Left panel: A young person sharing a bowl of food with an elderly, less privileged person sitting by the roadside. Right panel: Two students in school uniform, one helping the other study a textbook, with a speech bubble showing words of encouragement.
